name: zonetwo
description: Your training log, in conversation. Works with Garmin Connect.
long_description:
Zone Two reads your own Garmin Connect account so you can ask about it in plain language: sleep stages and score, overnight HRV against your baseline, Body Battery, stress, steps, weigh-ins, and activities with per-kilometre splits. It also answers "how am I doing today?" in a single call.

Sign in once. Enter your Garmin email and password below; if your account uses two-step verification, Garmin emails you a code and Claude asks for it in the conversation. After that a saved token keeps you signed in for about a year.

Everything runs on your own computer. Requests go straight to Garmin — there is no server in between and no analytics of any kind. Zone Two is not affiliated with or endorsed by Garmin; it uses the same private interface the Garmin Connect app uses, because Garmin's official API requires a commercial partner agreement.

email.title: Garmin email
email.description: The email address you sign in to Garmin Connect with.

password.title: Garmin password
password.description: Used once to obtain an access token, then stored only by Claude Desktop. Zone Two never writes it to disk.

enable_writes.title: Allow changes to my Garmin data
enable_writes.description: Off by default. When on, Claude may rename activities and log weight or hydration. Nothing can be deleted either way.
